purpose: Verify authenticated department user views announcements matching role, program, and year
preconditions: Published announcements exist with specific target scopes; user is authenticated
expected_result: Matching announcements are displayed in reverse chronological order

purpose: Verify user with no matching announcements receives empty result list
preconditions: Published announcements exist only for other cohorts/roles
expected_result: Empty list returned; non-matching announcements excluded

purpose: Verify unauthenticated user cannot view protected department announcements
preconditions: Unauthenticated request made to announcement view interface
expected_result: Authentication failure or 401 Unauthorized response returned

purpose: Verify authorized user creates draft and publishes announcement with target audience
preconditions: Actor has department.announcement.publish permission
action_or_input: Create draft and publish with target_roles, target_programs, and target_academic_years
expected_result: Announcement transitions to published status, published_at is set, notifications triggered

purpose: Verify draft announcement can be saved without immediate publishing
preconditions: Actor has publish permission
action_or_input: Call create_draft with title and body only
expected_result: Announcement saved with published_at None and is_active False

purpose: Verify unauthorized user (Student) is blocked from creating/publishing announcements
preconditions: Actor is Student lacking publish permission
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify publishing with missing audience targeting lists is rejected
preconditions: Draft announcement exists
action_or_input: Publish with empty target_roles, programs, or years
expected_result: ConflictError / ValidationError raised

purpose: Verify HOD can edit active announcement content
preconditions: Published active announcement exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD updates title and body of active announcement
expected_result: Updated title and body saved

purpose: Verify HOD can hide active department announcement
preconditions: Published active announcement exists; actor is HOD
expected_result: is_hidden set to True; announcement excluded from active listings

purpose: Verify HOD can delete active department announcement
preconditions: Published active announcement exists; actor is HOD
expected_result: deleted_at timestamp set; announcement excluded from active listings

purpose: Verify non-HOD (e.g. Dept_Admin) cannot hide or delete active announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify Faculty can request stock item when requested quantity <= available inventory
preconditions: InventoryItem exists with sufficient stock; actor is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty submits request for valid quantity and purpose
expected_result: StockRequest created in Pending HOD Approval status

purpose: Verify stock request rejected when requested quantity exceeds current inventory
preconditions: InventoryItem current quantity = 5
expected_result: Validation error raised and request is not accepted

purpose: Verify non-Faculty actor (e.g. Student) cannot submit stock request
preconditions: Actor is Student lacking stock request permission
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify HOD can approve pending stock request
preconditions: StockRequest in Pending HOD Approval status; actor is HOD
expected_result: Status transitions to Approved for Issuance; decided_at recorded

purpose: Verify HOD can reject pending stock request with note
preconditions: StockRequest in Pending HOD Approval status; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD rejects request with decision note
expected_result: Status transitions to Rejected; decision_note and decided_at recorded

purpose: Verify non-HOD actor cannot decide stock request
preconditions: StockRequest in Pending HOD Approval; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin issues HOD-approved stock, decrements inventory, and logs audit record
preconditions: StockRequest is in Approved for Issuance status; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: Status transitions to Issued, inventory quantity decremented, StockMovement logged

purpose: Verify stock issuance rejected when request is not approved by HOD
preconditions: StockRequest is in Pending status
expected_result: Operation blocked with validation or conflict error

purpose: Verify non-Dept_Admin actor cannot issue stock
preconditions: Approved StockRequest; actor is Faculty
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify authenticated Student/Faculty submits feedback and Dept_Admin is notified
preconditions: Actor is authenticated Student or Faculty
expected_result: Feedback saved in New status; notification dispatched to Dept_Admin

purpose: Verify unauthenticated submission is rejected
preconditions: Unauthenticated request
action_or_input: Attempt to submit feedback without authentication
expected_result: Authentication error returned

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin performs initial review and categorizes feedback
preconditions: Feedback in New status; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: Status changes to Under Review / Categorized

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin closes simple issue directly during initial review
preconditions: Simple issue feedback under initial review; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks closed with resolution note
expected_result: Status transitions to Closed; submitter notified

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin marks feedback resolved after review
preconditions: Feedback under review; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: Status transitions to Resolved; submitter notified

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update general department details immediately
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin; general non-official field updated
expected_result: Department details updated immediately without approval requirement

purpose: Verify official department detail change enters Pending HOD Approval
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin proposing official change (e.g. name or policy)
expected_result: Change placed in Pending HOD Approval; current data effective

purpose: Verify attempt to modify Headship identity via official details is blocked
preconditions: Actor attempts to change Headship identity through department details
expected_result: Modification rejected; Headship identity is synchronized only from active HOD role

purpose: Verify HOD approves pending official change and updated data becomes effective
preconditions: Official change in Pending HOD Approval; actor is HOD
expected_result: Change becomes effective in department record

purpose: Verify HOD rejects official change and current data is retained
preconditions: Official change in Pending HOD Approval; actor is HOD
expected_result: Change rejected; existing department data remains intact

purpose: Verify HOD resolves feedback after Dept_Admin initial review
preconditions: Feedback in Under Review status; actor is HOD
expected_result: Feedback transitions to Resolved status; submitter notified

purpose: Verify HOD oversight prohibited prior to Dept_Admin initial review
preconditions: Feedback in New status (not yet reviewed)
expected_result: Action blocked; initial review precondition not met

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin inserts inventory stock, quantity updates, and immutable audit log is created
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Insert stock record with name, unit, and initial quantity
expected_result: InventoryItem created and StockMovement insertion log recorded

purpose: Verify central Institute Admin assigns time-bound HOD or Dept_Admin role
preconditions: Actor is central Institute Admin
action_or_input: Create time-bound role assignment for department employee
expected_result: Valid role assignment recorded for effective transition

purpose: Verify non-Institute Admin actor cannot assign department roles
preconditions: Actor is HOD or Dept_Admin
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify system applies role transition: outgoing role revoked, incoming role granted, Headship synced
preconditions: Recorded role assignment reaches effective date
expected_result: Outgoing role access revoked, incoming role active, Headship synchronized
